name: ad-creative
description: Checks ad text before it runs and reads creative tests after. Counts every field against dated Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok limits, screens each line against dated platform rules and US, UK and EU claim rules with their source pages, and gives each ad Ready, Fix or Hold with fixed text. Tells you which ad won, whether the gap is real and how much longer a test needs. Also drafts search and social ad text, and ad angles from your reviews, using the facts you give and no invented figures. Works only on text and numbers you paste; makes no images or video and changes nothing in any ad account.

interface.longDescription: Five skills for checking ad text before it runs and reading creative tests after. Ad preflight counts each field of the ad text you paste against dated limits for Google search and Performance Max, Meta Feed and Reels, LinkedIn single image and TikTok in-feed, using each platform's own counting rule, and shows where the feed will cut the text. It then screens every line against platform rules and US, UK and EU claim rules, each with its source page and read date, lists each claim and the proof it needs, checks the offer against your landing text, and gives each ad a Ready, Fix or Hold verdict. Ad test readout fixes the main metric first, gives each rate with a 95% range, says whether the gap between ads is real or noise and whether the comparison was a true split test, and works out how many more impressions and days a test needs. Search ad set and social ad set draft ad text from the facts you give, in your words, with no invented figures; search sets are checked so any three headlines read well together. Angle matrix turns reviews and comments into ad angles, each traced to what customers said. Fields the plugin has no checked limit for are reported as unknown, and rows older than six months are flagged for re-checking. No images, video, spending or account changes.
defaultPrompt: Count and rule-check this Reels ad: 'Struggling with anxiety? AcmeCalm is the #1 app doctors recommend — 50% off today only!'
Ad A: 40,000 impressions, 520 clicks, 26 sales. Ad B: 38,000, 610, 22. Same ad set, 10 days. Which one won?
15 RSA headlines + 4 descriptions for a payroll app. Facts: 14-day trial, no card to try, from $39/mo, setup in one day.
